count_likelihood: joint independent-unit Poisson given causal covariates; normalized by common observed unit-bin mask
history_transform: log1p(count); strictly previous bins, reset every trial
task: encoding and maintenance indicators; load-6 indicators interacted with encoding/maintenance, zero during fixation
timing: six prespecified harmonics sin/cos over six-second trial and two task-phase indicators
drift: recorded trial number/metadata total trials, linear and quadratic; known schedule, no heldout count fitting
scaling: training design mean/std only, intercept unscaled, constant column scale1
ridge_objective: sum over units of per-bin mean negative Poisson log likelihood plus alpha/2 times squared nonintercept coefficients; separable per-unit fits
solver: scipy L-BFGS-B analytic gradient, maxiter500, ftol1e-12, gtol1e-6; validate finite objective and gradient <=1e-4; any required candidate failure stops gate
selection: whole validation trial nats/unit-bin means; standard error of best candidate trial scores; keep candidates >=bestmean-bestSE, prefer fewest fitted parameters then larger ridge then family lexical order
fit: all six baselines, no final test access; full training fit per session-local unit; stationary exact MLE
free_parameters: one intercept per unit plus all fitted nonintercept coefficients per unit
scientific_scope: validation selection only; no inferential family winner or final holdout statistic
execution_prerequisite: M2 scientific PASS including exact NIX observation coverage
